backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access-controlled user profiles, stats, availability, chat storage, and admin operations like deleting users and clearing day data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of major frontend files including pages, hooks, and shared components.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based OKLCH color theme and CSS variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entrypoint mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app router and authentication gate handling identity, actor readiness, initialization timeout, error UI, and page layout.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen shown when a user lacks admin permissions, offering a return link.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGateErr: Error UI for failed auth or initialization with retry and reload actions.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login page using Internet Identity with branding and sign‑in button.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Renders a group chat panel that loads recent messages, resolves display names, and allows sending new messages.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Provides the main page layout with top bar, navigation, content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Displays navigation buttons and conditionally adds an admin link based on the user’s role.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Shows the header with app branding, theme toggle, user menu, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal prompting users to enter and save their display name on first setup.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wraps content with a fixed low‑opacity background image.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks to fetch and update the current user's profile via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Provides hooks to fetch the caller’s role and determine if they are an admin.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity login, stored identities, and exposes authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, availability, messages, and stats through the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Manages the light/dark theme preference and persists it to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch display names and user profiles for principals, falling back to truncated IDs.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and extensive CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Utility functions for converting dates to IDs, generating month grids, and formatting dates and times.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Form page for creating or editing availability for a selected day with time and notes.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard for deleting users or day data and viewing login activity with name resolution.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Monthly calendar view showing days with availability markers and navigation between months.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Simple wrapper page displaying the group chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Displays all availabilities for a specific day with user names, details, and option to add availability.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Provides a leaderboard page with time‑filter tabs and a table of player rankings, pulling data from hooks and allowing win/loss recording.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays the current user's profile, stats, streak, and placeholder sections for match history and settings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including support for hash‑based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending themes, colors, animations, and enabling typography, container queries, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing the app’s state, known issues, and feature requirements related to fixing post‑login loading behavior.
